scope: Proposed controlled comparisons; no architecture is admitted by this inventory and no local implementation has been installed or tested.

candidate.definition: nanoCOG packet decoder; independently trained local-only ablation is separate
required: Freeze actual experiment graph/configuration and checkpoint; reference source is not experimental admission.
Complete common tokenizer, optimizer, batching and serving integration.

checks: Freeze exact source revisions and dependency versions.
Verify causality, document isolation, reset behavior, finite gradients, and actual learning.
Verify reference, chunk, prefill, and incremental outputs within declared tolerances.
Qualify baseline competence at the chosen model size, training length, dataset, and regime before using a failure to support a claim.
Count embeddings, projections, gates, readout, indexers, and every retained state or external store.
Use equal-data and equal-compute panels separately; disclose total and non-embedding parameters and equal tuning budgets.
Measure complete sessions as well as prefill, cached decode, update/index costs, peak memory, and persistent state.
Report CPU and GPU results separately; record actual kernels, precision, batching, threads, warmup, compilation, and synchronization.
shared_admission.kernel_policy: FA2 and FA4 are backend choices for an attention architecture, not separate architecture families. Backend availability and numerical equivalence require local verification. GPU speed claims do not transfer to CPU.

baselines.proposed_comparable_configuration: Train a causal GQA Transformer in the shared model scaffold; select dimensions and KV-head grouping under the declared parameter/data or compute budget.

support_from_source.prefill: SDPA available subject to backend constraints.
support_from_source.decode: Requires explicit persistent KV-cache integration and position-aware masking.

caveats: Query-head count must be divisible by KV-head count; key and value head counts must agree.
SDPA non-square is_causal uses upper-left alignment; do not assume it is the correct cached-decode mask.
Disable SDPA dropout explicitly during evaluation.
FA2 supports Ampere/Ada/Hopper; FA4 targets Hopper/Blackwell. Confirm backend selection and supported shapes locally.
state_accounting: K and V for every retained token/layer
allocated cache capacity and any duplicated buffers

baselines.proposed_comparable_configuration: Train an MLA Transformer in the shared scaffold; freeze latent rank, head dimensions, positional treatment, and expanded-training/absorbed-inference equivalence.

released_checkpoint.note: A scaled MLA module is not the complete DeepSeek-V3 system.

support_from_source.train: A differentiable path must be selected and verified; the cited full-model inference forward is decorated with torch.inference_mode.
support_from_source.prefill: Official inference source exposes naive and absorb modes.
support_from_source.decode: Official absorbed path retains latent KV and positional-key caches indexed by start_pos.

caveats: Do not use inference-only code unchanged as a training implementation.
Verify naive/expanded and absorbed outputs before measuring cache savings.
An expanded-KV-only implementation cannot establish the efficiency of compressed-cache MLA.
state_accounting: expanded or transient cache copies and peak workspace

sources.date_note: Live source; exact commit not frozen.

baselines.proposed_comparable_configuration: Train Gated DeltaNet with declared periodic GQA or sliding-window attention in the common scaffold; freeze ratio, window, recurrent dimensions, and all ancillary layers.

support_from_source.train: FLA layer selects chunk mode when gradients are enabled.
support_from_source.prefill: Chunk path accepts an initial recurrent state and can return final state.
support_from_source.decode: FLA selects fused_recurrent for short inference and updates recurrent plus convolution caches.

caveats: Hybrid attention type and ratio must be named; pure GDN and a hybrid are separate configurations.
FLA CPU installation lists Triton as import-only; optimized CPU execution is not established.
Portable reference recurrence timings must not be presented as optimized GPU performance.
state_accounting: matrix recurrent state per recurrent layer

baselines.proposed_comparable_configuration: Train configurable KDA with a declared periodic attention component; 3:1 KDA:MLA is the official Kimi Linear arrangement, while KDA:GQA or KDA:SWA must be labeled as different variants.

released_checkpoint.note: Released checkpoint is not an equal-training baseline for a newly trained small model.

support_from_source.train: FLA provides configurable differentiable chunk-mode KDA.
support_from_source.prefill: Chunk mode accepts initial_state and output_final_state.
support_from_source.decode: Fused-recurrent path returns updated recurrent and convolution caches.

caveats: Preserve channelwise forget gates, gate normalization, convolution, and output gating.
Validate any small configuration; the released large-model quality and throughput claims do not automatically transfer.
CPU installation is not proof that optimized kernels execute on CPU.
state_accounting: MLA latent plus positional caches or the chosen attention cache

sources.date_note: Paper submission date; code revision not frozen.

baselines.proposed_comparable_configuration: Train configurable GDN2 with a declared attention ratio/window, preserving separate channelwise erase/write gates and channelwise decay; match the common budget and recurrent-state accounting.

released_checkpoint.note: Downscaled training does not reproduce the published 1.3B/100B-token result.

support_from_source.train: NVlabs training code and FLA differentiable chunk implementation exist.
support_from_source.prefill: FLA chunk_gdn2 accepts initial_state and can return final state.
support_from_source.decode: FLA fused_recurrent_gdn2 updates recurrent and convolution caches.

caveats: Do not collapse erase/write gates into one scalar and still call it GDN2.
Source availability does not establish local execution or numerical correctness.
Confirm CPU/reference versus optimized accelerator path separately.

baselines.proposed_comparable_configuration: Conditional faithful reduced CSA2 study only after defining indexer training, cross-layer sharing, compression, window behavior, quantization, and cached decode. Otherwise name the model CSA2-inspired and restrict the claim.

released_checkpoint.note: A released large checkpoint may be a separately labeled practical-system reference; not an equal-data architecture control.

support_from_source.train: NeMo offers differentiable full-sequence CSA2 with eager, SDPA, and TileLang; the released indexer remains frozen.
support_from_source.prefill: Full-sequence attention supported; this alone does not certify a reusable decode cache.
support_from_source.decode: KV-cache decoding explicitly unsupported by the cited NeMo training implementation; a separate inference path must be integrated and verified.

blocking_conditions: The released indexer is frozen because hard top-k supplies no LM gradient and the inference release lacks indexer distillation.
A from-scratch trainable selector protocol must be specified rather than silently using an untrained/frozen random selector.
Complete cached decoding must pass equivalence before session-cost admission.
caveats: Faithfulness includes Full/Reindex/Reuse cross-layer modes and hierarchical sparse selection.
NeMo preserves FP8 window and FP4 compressed KV/indexer quantize/dequantize boundaries while dequantizing weights for training.
Full-model DeepSeek improvements also involve components beyond CSA2; do not attribute them all to attention.
state_accounting: top-k selections and hierarchical candidate pools

baselines.proposed_comparable_configuration: Separately train the candidate local-only backbone under the same data, tuning and declared capacity policy; no packet memory in training or inference.

support_from_source.train: Candidate README exposes LocalOnly; common training integration pending.
support_from_source.prefill: Full decoder and state-adapter parity pending.
support_from_source.decode: Local and previous-embedding state must be carried correctly.

caveats: Same-checkpoint packet masking is a causal intervention, not this retrained control.
Meaningful capacity differences must be reported without dead-parameter padding.

inherited_diagnostic_controls.purpose: Preserve unchanged direct-event and matched-broker lineage where executable on a comparable relational diagnostic; not a general-LM competitor.
requirements: Exact original source, weights, recipe and permitted comparable evaluation inputs.
Keep frozen snapshot replay distinct from retraining.
If unavailable, record UNAVAILABLE and narrow the claim; never silently substitute or drop the inherited control.

inherited_diagnostic_controls.purpose: Parser/exact store and tuned lexical/recency controls receive actor-visible text; parser errors and all costs count.
